firm_data.firm_description: Vladeck, Raskin & Clark, P.C. is an employment law firm protecting and advancing workers’ rights. The firm also handles criminal defense and disability rights cases.
notable_facts: Nationally recognized as a preeminent employment law firm.
Represents employees at every level in various industries.

email.subject: AI for Vladeck, Raskin & Clark - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lisa,

Vladeck, Raskin & Clark has been advancing workers' rights since 1949, and that mission demands precision across employment law, discrimination, and labor cases. Teams built for impact, not overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
